relations.predicate: is applied to the output of
relations.quote: Recovery is applied to the output of the [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md), after the known normalizations and digit scales are removed.
Recovery undoes the [phase twist](phase-twist.md) before the coefficients are read, which restores the original cyclic wrap-around.
Exact recovery is secured by the [Guard-width bound](guard-width-bound.md), which fixes enough extra bits that a single final truncation, discarding those bits, suffices.
